KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

2. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

6. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. fupi
   C. zito
   D. nene

7. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   C. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. kitoto
   C. mato
   D. watoto

9. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain uliopita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Lishe Bora and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma: Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
